candidates.statement: Checkout returns 502 because the order service's call to payment (/v1/authorizations) hits a transport ReadTimeout (~2s), so order fails and gateway checkout fails; payment is the slow downstream.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side latency metrics/logs not admitted; payment slowness inferred from client-side ReadTimeout spans only.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s driven by order->payment ReadTimeout transport errors (~2s), while inventory/redis calls succeed. Gateway metrics show 16 checkout 502s and p95 ~2425ms. Bounded candidate: downstream payment latency.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics to confirm payment-side slowness
Payment service logs or traces for the timed-out /v1/authorizations requests
